method: SSR imports current profiles and executes actual applyArtDirection with the canonical JSON via a read-only mock fetch. No textures are loaded and no GPU is created. Every source instance matrix and geometry buffer is checked unchanged.
scope: Original inventory and visual judgments are not edited. Raster audit decisions are inherited from the texture review, not a claim of separate visual inspection of every repeated mesh. Configured motion is different from continuously active motion; visibility and quotas apply. HTML text is listed separately from mesh instances.
